Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: a Korean explanatory infographic for a formal university partnership proposal.
Create one polished landscape 2000 x 1000 pixel image, approximately 2:1. This is a newly created conceptual diagram, not a transformation of earlier photos.
Visual direction: newspaper-article-style explanatory clarity, clean white and very pale blue background, navy #0F2E54, blue #174EA6 and cyan #069EEA. Modest dimensional icons, subtle soft shadows, rigorously aligned cards, generous whitespace. Information must be clearer and more prominent than decorative icons. Crisp, large, legible Korean sans-serif text, perfect Korean spelling, clean typographic hierarchy. No newspaper page, masthead, article columns, newspaper logo, company logo, seals, photos, watermarks or texture behind letters.
Layout:
At the top, a large navy title exactly: "지원자 사전 확인".
Below, four equally sized aligned cards in one horizontal row. Each card contains one small understated dimensional icon, a bold Korean label, and its supporting phrase in large readable Korean:
Card 1: label "학력·서류"; supporting phrase "원본·신원 대조". A neutral document and identity-check icon.
Card 2: label "한국어"; supporting phrase "대학 기준 확인". A neutral speech bubble icon containing no letters.
Card 3: label "재정 계획"; supporting phrase "증빙·부담액 확인". A neutral wallet or simple ledger icon, no currency numbers.
Card 4: label "전공 적합성"; supporting phrase "학업계획 면담". A neutral study-plan or conversation icon, no letters.
These four cards are parallel review criteria, not sequential admission decisions. Under them, thin arrows lead downward from all four cards to one centered horizontal output bar with the exact text: "점검표·보완 이력 → 대학 심사". Use the arrow symbol between the two text phrases visibly and clearly, with spacing.
At the bottom, place the large, prominent sentence exactly: "최종 입학 결정은 대학이 담당합니다."
All quoted Korean text is mandatory and must be rendered verbatim, including the middle dots and punctuation. Do not add any other words, numbers, percentages, claims, decorative lettering or badges. No admission, visa, employment, official accreditation or outcome guarantee. The university is the final admission decision maker; the four cards describe only advance review and the handoff of records for university review.
assets.visual_validation: 모든 지정 문구를 읽어 일치 확인. 네 검토 항목이 병렬로 대학 심사에 연결되고 대학의 최종 입학 결정 문구가 유지됨.

Visual direction: newspaper-article-style explanatory clarity, clean white and very pale blue background, navy #0F2E54, blue #174EA6 and cyan #069EEA. Modest dimensional icons, subtle soft shadows, rigorously aligned cards, generous whitespace. Information must be clearer and more prominent than decorative icons. Crisp, large, legible Korean sans-serif text, perfect Korean spelling, clean typographic hierarchy. Layout:
At the top, a large navy title exactly: "준비교육 운영 과정".
Below, five aligned cards in one horizontal row. Each card has one understated dimensional icon with no lettering and one large, bold Korean label. The exact card labels, left to right, are:
"진단" → "목표 협의" → "수업·실습" → "평가" → "보완".
Use clear blue forward arrows between the five cards. A neutral clipboard or magnifier icon for diagnosis, a discussion icon for goal agreement, a book and simple practice-tool icon for lessons/practice, a clipboard-check icon for assessment, and a neutral adjustment or repair icon for supplementary learning.
Feedback must be represented clearly: from the last card "보완", two thin cyan return paths run below the row and lead back upward with visible arrowheads to the first card "진단" and the third card "수업·실습". These are backward feedback arrows, not new stages. Route the return arrows in the whitespace below the cards without crossing labels or confusing the forward arrows. Do not add labels to the return paths.
At the bottom, two large clean information panels, side by side, containing exactly these phrases:
Left panel: "한국어 + 전공 기초"
Right panel: "교육기간·시수는 대학과 협의"
Make both phrases fully legible and uncut; a deliberate two-line wrap inside the right panel is acceptable if needed, while preserving every word and punctuation.
All quoted Korean text is mandatory and must be rendered verbatim, including the middle dots and plus sign. Do not add any other words, step numbers, durations, quantities, percentages, decorative lettering or badges. In particular do not add a fixed three-to-six-month duration. No admission, visa, employment, official accreditation or outcome guarantee. The visual describes an iterative proposed preparation-education workflow; the period and instructional hours are agreed with the university.
assets.visual_validation: 모든 지정 문구를 읽어 일치 확인. 진단→목표 협의→수업·실습→평가→보완의 순서와 보완에서 진단·수업·실습으로 돌아가는 피드백 화살표 확인.

images.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: formal explanatory infographic for a Korean university cooperation proposal.
Create one polished horizontal image, approximately 2000 x 1000 pixels (2:1). White or very pale blue background. Navy #0F2E54, brand blue #174EA6, cyan #069EEA. A newspaper-style explanatory hierarchy with a clean contemporary editorial finish: dimensional icons, soft subtle shadows, aligned rounded cards, generous whitespace and very large, crisp, highly legible Korean typography. This is an infographic, not a newspaper page.
Layout: large title at top, five equal and clearly separated role cards in one well-balanced aligned row, then a short explanatory line and footer. These are independent institutional roles, not a sequence or approval pipeline. Do not draw connecting process arrows between the five institutions.
Render this Korean text EXACTLY, with the same middle dots and spacing:
Title: "기관별 역할과 결정권"
Card 1 institution: "대학"
Card 1 role: "입학·학사 결정"
Card 1 small plain text tag: "결정권"
Card 2 institution: "정우"
Card 2 role: "자료 취합·일정·보고"
Card 2 small plain text tag: "지원·수행"
Card 3 institution: "현지기관"
Card 3 role: "상담·교육·평가 기록"
Card 3 small plain text tag: "지원·수행"
Card 4 institution: "기업"
Card 4 role: "직무·근로조건·채용"
Card 4 small plain text tag: "결정권"
Card 5 institution: "출입국관서"
Card 5 role: "체류자격 심사·허가"
Card 5 small plain text tag: "결정권"
Explanatory line: "정우는 입학·채용·체류허가를 대신 결정하지 않습니다."
Footer: "협약에서 수행자·확인자·결정자를 정합니다."
Icons: university building with an open book; a neutral clipboard/calendar/report for Jungwoo; an education notebook and speech bubble for the local institution; a company/factory and briefcase; a plain office building and review folder/magnifier for the immigration office. Logical constraints: make the decision authority of university, company and immigration office clear and equal. Jungwoo and the local institution provide support/execution and must not appear to replace the three decision-making institutions. Preserve all requested words; do not add other words, numbers, dates, quotations, logos, mastheads, watermarks, guarantees or fabricated achievements. No government seal or approval symbol. Clear typography matters more than decorative detail. Opaque background; one finished image.

review.korean_text: 제목, 기관 5개, 역할 5개, 결정권/지원·수행 표기, 정우의 결정권 제한 문장, 협약 문구 확인

record.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: Korean university cooperation proposal, explanatory infographic for an appendix cross-reference.
Primary request: create a polished Korean editorial infographic with FOUR independent information cards. This is a selected set of review topics, not an exhaustive classification of all visas and not a sequence of mandatory stages.
Canvas: approximately 2000 x 1000 pixels, wide 2:1 aspect ratio, opaque white and pale-blue background.
Style: newspaper-style explanatory information graphic with crisp editorial typography and a card layout; tasteful small dimensional icons with soft shadows; generous safe margins; large Korean letters, easy to read at half size.
Color palette: navy #0F2E54, blue #174EA6, cyan #069EEA, white and pale blue. Use the palette consistently.
Composition: large title at the top. Four equal independent cards in a 2-by-2 grid beneath the title, with balanced whitespace and clear alignment. Each card has a small icon on its left and large text on its right. The cards have NO arrows or connecting lines. A footer statement below all four cards and a small final separate cross-reference box at the bottom.
Text, verbatim, with exactly these strings and no additional wording:
Title: "체류자격별 별도 확인"
Top-left card title: "D-2 재학"
Top-left card body: "학업 중심·활동 허가 확인"
Top-right card title: "D-10 구직"
Top-right card body: "구직·인턴 조건 확인"
Bottom-left card title: "E-7 취업"
Bottom-left card body: "직종·기업·계약 확인"
Bottom-right card title: "F-2-R 지역특화"
Bottom-right card body: "지역 추천·거주·소득 확인"
Footer: "자동 전환이 아닙니다. 학생별 요건과 관할 심사를 확인합니다."
Final small box: "세부 요건: 부록 A"
Icons: books for D-2; magnifying glass and a plain document for D-10; a briefcase and plain contract sheet for E-7; a map pin, house and simple coin for F-2-R. Icons have no readable text.
Accuracy constraints: reproduce every Korean character, Latin letter, hyphen, middle dot, colon and period exactly. Do not insert eligibility requirements, legal conclusions, durations, wages, percentages, rankings, stage numbers or new labels. Do not imply automatic visa conversion, required sequence, admission, employment guarantee, government endorsement, success or approval. Do not indicate that the four cards exhaust every residence status.
Avoid: logos, newspaper brands, government emblems, visa stamps, checkmark success badges, trophies, seals, watermarks, decorative arrows. Do not include photos or people. Keep all text fully visible and uncut.

qa.title_and_all_card_labels: Visually confirmed against the supplied Korean strings.
qa.footer_and_appendix_reference: Visually confirmed against the supplied Korean strings.
